title: Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking - Mid-Term 2025
instructions: Answer all questions. Part A is compulsory (10 Marks). Answer any two from Part B (40 Marks).

sections.sectionTitle: Part A: Short Questions (5 x 2 = 10 Marks)
Part B: Detailed Analytical Questions (2 x 20 = 40 Marks)

title: Engineering Mathematics I - End Semester Examination 2024
instructions: Answer all questions from Section A (20 Marks). Answer any 4 questions from Section B (80 Marks).

sections.sectionTitle: Section A: Short Answer Questions (2 Marks Each)

questions.text: State Cayley-Hamilton theorem and verify it for a 2x2 identity matrix.
Find the eigenvalues of matrix A = [[3, 1], [0, 2]].
Define radius of curvature in Cartesian coordinates.
Evaluate limit as x approaches 0 of (sin x - x) / x^3 using L'Hopital's rule.
State Euler's theorem for homogeneous functions of degree n.

sections.sectionTitle: Section B: Long Descriptive & Numerical Problems (20 Marks Each)

questions.text: Diagonalize the matrix A = [[1, 6, 1], [1, 2, 0], [0, 0, 3]] using orthogonal transformation.
Find the maximum and minimum values of f(x, y, z) = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 subject to the constraint x + y + z = 1 using Lagrange's multipliers.
Evaluate the double integral over the region bounded by y = x^2 and y = x.
Verify Stokes Theorem for the vector field F = (2x - y)i - yz^2 j - y^2 z k over the upper half of sphere x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 1.

title: Programming in C & Data Structures - End Semester 2024
instructions: All questions in Part A are compulsory. Answer any 5 questions from Part B.

sections.sectionTitle: Part A: Core Concepts (10 x 2 = 20 Marks)

questions.text: Explain difference between pass-by-value and pass-by-reference in C using pointers.
What is the time complexity of searching in a Balanced Binary Search Tree (AVL Tree)?
Differentiate between malloc() and calloc() dynamic memory functions in C.
Convert infix expression ((A + B) * C - D) to Postfix expression using stack evaluation.

sections.sectionTitle: Part B: Algorithms & Code Implementation (16 Marks Each)

questions.text: Write a complete C program to implement a Singly Linked List with insertion, deletion, and reverse operations.
Implement QuickSort algorithm in C. Explain Partition function with time complexity analysis in best, average, and worst cases.
Explain Breadth First Search (BFS) and Depth First Search (DFS) graph traversal with examples and queue/stack state representations.

title: Object-Oriented Programming (Java) - End Semester 2024
instructions: Answer all questions. Show code snippets clearly.

sections.sectionTitle: Section A: OOP Fundamentals & JVM Architecture

questions.text: Explain the four pillars of OOP (Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, Abstraction) in Java with code snippets.
Explain Java Garbage Collection mechanisms and finalize() method lifecycle.
Write a Java program demonstrating Producer-Consumer problem using inter-thread communication (wait, notify, and notifyAll).
Design a custom banking Exception `InsufficientFundsException` and handle it with try-catch-finally blocks.

title: Machine Learning & Deep Neural Nets - End Semester 2024
instructions: Scientific calculators are permitted. Show intermediate gradient calculations.

questions.text: Derive the gradient update rule for Linear Regression with L2 Regularization (Ridge Regression). Explain bias-variance tradeoff.
Explain Support Vector Machines (SVM) maximum margin formulation with soft-margin slack variables and kernel trick (RBF kernel).
Derive Backpropagation equations for a 3-layer Multilayer Perceptron with Cross-Entropy loss and Softmax activation.
Explain Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN): Convolution layer, Stride, Padding, Pooling, and Feature Maps.
Compare Dropout, Batch Normalization, and Early Stopping techniques for preventing overfitting in Deep Neural Networks.

title: Advanced Cloud Architecture & DevOps - End Semester 2024

questions.text: Compare Monolithic Architecture vs Microservices Architecture in Cloud. Detail API Gateway, Service Discovery, and Circuit Breaker patterns.
Explain Kubernetes Architecture: Control Plane (API Server, Etcd, Controller Manager, Scheduler) and Worker Nodes (Kubelet, Kube-Proxy, Container Runtime).
Design a fault-tolerant multi-region cloud deployment on AWS/GCP with Auto Scaling, Load Balancer, and Read Replicas database.
Construct a complete CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions / Jenkins with automated linting, unit testing, Docker containerization, and blue-green deployment.
